source_text.heading: The Backwards Law
source_text.body_text: His success didn't come from wanting it more; it came from accepting who he was and writing from that honest baseline without trying to prove anything. Manson saw the same law in his own life. The boldest moves he ever made (quitting a corporate job and moving overseas) only happened when he stopped obsessing over the outcome.
other_story_text: Lifting the concept from philosopher Alan Watts, Manson calls this the Backwards Law.
